# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen or eighteen at the end of volume three  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v3 c37 P33](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0033)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is considered fat by her classmates, but she possesses a malicious smile. She is the last of the Pye family to attend the Avonlea school. Later in her youth, it is noted that she will likely grow up to resemble her relative, Aunt Atossa.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v2 c11 P40](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0040), [v3 c11 P40](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0040)_

## Personality

Josie is known for her sharp tongue, vanity, and malicious demeanor. She frequently cheats, sulks when she does not get her way, and delights in the misfortunes and embarrassments of others. She displays a distinct lack of imagination and is generally disliked by her peers for her spiteful and arrogant behavior.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v2 c9 P6](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0006), [v3 c2 P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003)_

- Malicious  <sub>[v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047)</sub>

## Abilities

- Walking board fences with skill  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- To attend college for education's sake without needing to earn a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Josie Pye attends Avonlea School alongside Anne Shirley and her peers. She earns a reputation among her classmates as a cheat and a spiteful girl. During a party at the Barry home, Josie dares Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, which leads to Anne falling and breaking her ankle. Later, Josie joins the Queen's Academy preparation class and passes the entrance examinations. After attending Queen's, she continues her studies at Redmond College alongside Anne and their friends. During their time at Redmond, she frequently makes barbed and envious comments toward Anne, such as accusing her of copying her prize-winning story.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v3 c2 P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003), [v3 c15 P3](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0003)_

## Background by volume

- Belongs to the Avonlea Pye family  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- Daughter of a family wealthy enough to send her to college without financial strain  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014)</sub>
- Relative of Aunt Atossa Coates  <sub>[v3 c11 P40](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0040)</sub>
